needs_review.issue: Two-name slug, title does not name anyone
needs_review.finding: https://cadence.org/missionary/tim-and-rebecca-hawkins returned under the title 'Redirection - Cadence International'. Slug names Tim and Rebecca Hawkins; the title names no one, so the page may be a redirect or a rewritten/retired profile.
needs_review.evidence: Search result: title 'Redirection - Cadence International', url https://cadence.org/missionary/tim-and-rebecca-hawkins
needs_review.recommendation: Do not emit from the slug alone. Fetch the page once fetching is enabled and confirm whether one or both Hawkinses are still serving before adding them.

needs_review.issue: Two-name slug, title names only one spouse
needs_review.finding: https://cadence.org/missionary/jay-and-jerri-kayll/ carries the title 'Jerri Kayll - Cadence International'. Jerri is emitted (she also has her own page at /missionary/jerri-kayll/). Jay Kayll is named only in the slug. Per the standing rule a two-name slug can outlive one of the two people.
needs_review.evidence: Two distinct results: 'Jerri Kayll' at /missionary/jerri-kayll/ and 'Jerri Kayll' at /missionary/jay-and-jerri-kayll/
needs_review.recommendation: Do not emit Jay Kayll. Verify his status on the page before any outreach.

needs_review.finding: https://cadence.org/missionary/larry-and-bb-blakely/ is titled 'Larry & BB Blakely'. Larry is emitted; the spouse appears only as 'BB', which is not a usable given name.
needs_review.evidence: Search result title 'Larry & BB Blakely - Cadence International'
needs_review.recommendation: Hold the spouse. If a full first name appears on the page, add her then; otherwise leave her out.

needs_review.issue: Exclusion sweeps saturated on this slice
needs_review.finding: Contrary to wave n, -surname exclusion chains stopped producing on the role axis. The engine cycles between two fixed clusters of ~10 cadence.org/missionary results and re-serves an already-excluded name (e.g. Amor, Argueta, Bloker, Auldridge) even when that surname is in the exclusion list, so added exclusions no longer shift the result set. Four of the eight sweeps returned nothing new; the last sweep returned zero new slugs.
needs_review.evidence: Sweeps 11, 12, 14, 16 and 18 in coverage[] returned only slugs already held from earlier queries in this run.
needs_review.recommendation: Stop buying exclusion sweeps against bare site:cadence.org/missionary. Pair exclusions with a narrow qualifier (a single base name, a single role phrase) so the engine has to re-rank, or wait for a fetch-enabled pass against https://cadence.org/missionary-directory/, which surfaced repeatedly as an index page.

needs_review.issue: Directory index page seen again but not fetchable
needs_review.finding: https://cadence.org/missionary-directory/ appeared in three separate role-axis searches. It is the roster index and would almost certainly close out this domain in one fetch.
needs_review.recommendation: Queue for the fetch-enabled pass; it is worth more than another search-only wave here.
